name: Hope We'll Still be Friends Tomorrow
summary:
Melody's night shift has made it harder for her to spend time with her two friends, Vivienne and Amber. On a night Melody must work, Vivienne and Amber go to a party together. But during that party something terrible happens between them.

With the help of a new friend, Melody must figure out what happened at the party and how to make things better—or worse—for her crush Vivienne, who has gotten the worst of it.
